args.description: Pixel Heaven native pixel art. Slightly overhead 3/4 RPG view, orthogonal ground (not isometric diamond), upper-left light, crisp 1px clusters, selective dark outlines, warm muted limited palette. Transparent background, no text, no watermark, no scene or ground platform, entire silhouette inside canvas. Home swordsman: short steel sword in RIGHT hand and broad round shield in LEFT, sage green cloth, round shield emblem, silver helmet and light armor. Full body facing south. Native 32x48, visible adult height 40 pixels, top 8 pixels empty, feet at bottom ground anchor (16,48), no enlarged chibi head. Modest practical clothing.
